subject.title: fix(codex): prefer recovered replies over stale failure banners

question: Should failed Codex conversation turns be allowed to resolve from partial streamed deltas, or only from completed assistant-message evidence?
rationale: The safe implementation can be mechanical, but accepting partial deltas as enough to replace a failure banner is a user-visible delivery contract choice that source inspection alone should not decide.

options.title: Require Completed Assistant Evidence
options.body: Only suppress failed-turn errors when `item/completed` or `turn.items` contains completed assistant-message text, while partial-delta-only failures still reject.

options.title: Accept Partial Delta Delivery
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept partial deltas as successful output, but should require live Slack/Codex proof for both recovered and unrecovered failed turns.

options.title: Pause For Codex Contract
options.body: Pause this PR until upstream Codex exposes a clearer recovered-versus-fatal completion signal.

recommendation.title: Require Completed Assistant Evidence
recommendation.body: Only suppress failed-turn errors when `item/completed` or `turn.items` contains completed assistant-message text, while partial-delta-only failures still reject.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has recent Codex binding history and already gave related maintainer direction that final assistant text is not enough recovery proof.
